title: Run repository code and tests in the sandbox
what: The sandbox is offline and has no checkout, so the agent cannot build or test what it changes. Design a checkout with an allowlisted network (the git host and package registries), credentials that never enter the container, and bounded time and disk.

acceptance.text: The agent can check out a repository at a ref in its sandbox and run its tests
Network access is limited to an allowlist and no credential is visible inside the container
